exotel PyPI package compromised via phishing.

Target: exotel
Repository: https://github.com/exotel/exotel-python
Date: 2022-08-01 to 2022-08-31 (30 days)
Attribution: Cybercriminal Gang
Component: Library
Language: Python
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Data Exfiltration
User Impact: 480000
Domain: pypi.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The PyPI account for the exotel package maintainer was compromised during the JuiceLedger phishing campaign. Attackers uploaded version 0.1.6 with installation code that downloaded and executed infostealer malware, making a niche Python client a clean-looking vessel for credential theft across developer workstations.
